title: Credentials
subtitle: Keys the MCP servers use on behalf of agents. Thulu checks each key, reads what it can do and keeps the secret out of every prompt.
cross_html: Model keys (Anthropic, OpenAI) go in AI engines.

ghapp.title: GitHub App
ghapp.lede: An installed App mints a short-lived token per operation, scoped to one repository, and stores nothing long-lived. Without one, each project uses a personal access token from the list above.
ghapp.env_note: Set through environment variables ({var} and the rest). Change it in the deployment. A value saved here would never be read.
ghapp.form_lede: Register an App on GitHub with Contents and Pull requests write and Actions read; without Actions no push or pull request works. Checks read is optional and adds the status of any CI. Then paste what GitHub gives you.
ghapp.app_id_hint: On the App's settings page, under About.
ghapp.private_key_hint: Open the .pem file GitHub generated and paste all of it.
ghapp.more_hint: Optional. Only needed for GitHub sign-in and webhook events.
ghapp.read_only: The GitHub App serves every workspace on this install.
ghapp.installations_empty: Not installed on any organization yet. Install it so projects can mint tokens for their repositories.
ghapp.create_lede: GitHub opens its form with the permissions, the webhook and this Thulu's URLs filled in. You confirm the name, GitHub creates the App and sends you back here with the App connected.
ghapp.create_org_hint: Optional. Left empty, the App belongs to your personal account.
ghapp.create_url: GitHub will send webhooks to {url}/github/webhook and bring you back to {url}.
ghapp.create_url_private: GitHub cannot reach {host}: it is a local or private address, so the App will receive no webhooks. Open Thulu at its public address before you create it.
ghapp.create_deploy: Agents dispatch workflows or approve deployments (adds Actions and Deployments write)
ghapp.perm_missing: The App lacks permissions Thulu needs: {perms}. Pushes and pull requests will fail until you add them in the App's settings on GitHub and accept the change on each installation.
ghapp.perm_recommended: The App lacks {perms}. It works, but the task's pull request section will only see GitHub Actions checks.
ghapp.created: GitHub App created and connected. Install it on an organization so projects can use it.

manifest_errors.unavailable: This daemon has no GitHub integration.
manifest_errors.state: The registration expired or was opened in another browser. Start again from Create the App on GitHub.
manifest_errors.configured: An App was already connected, so the new one was not saved. Remove the current one to use the new one.
manifest_errors.convert: GitHub did not hand over the App's credentials. The App may exist on GitHub: delete it there or connect it by hand.
manifest_errors.validate: The App was created but its credentials failed the check. Connect it by hand from Connect an existing App.
manifest_errors.store: The App was created but could not be saved. Connect it by hand from Connect an existing App.
manifest_errors.other: The App could not be created.

add.title: New credential
add.hint: Stored encrypted. No endpoint returns the secret and no agent sees it.
add.name_hint: How people and agents refer to it, for example {example}.
add.grants_hint: A task can use the key when one of these is on the task. Bind a cloud key to its environment, since an agent runs across every project.
add.use_in_project: Use it in a project: open Repository → GitHub access and pick it.

detail.tools_hint: Greyed rows need a permission the key lacks. Turn the rest on or off.
detail.grants_hint: Tasks on these projects and environments can use the key.
detail.rotate_hint: The new key replaces the old one. Who may use it and which tools are on stay the same.
detail.permissions_unknown: Could not find out what this key allows: every tool stays enabled.
detail.group_toggle: Turn every {group} tool on or off

reasons.no_credential: no credential reachable for that resource
reasons.ambiguous_credential: several candidates; the agent must name one

empty.credentials: Add an AWS, Google Cloud or GitHub key and pick the projects that may use it.
empty.refusals: No refusals among the last 100 decisions.
empty.decisions: No tool call has used a credential yet. Each one shows up here, allowed or refused, with the reason.
empty.projects: No projects yet. Create one to grant access per project or environment.

confirm.ghapp_remove_message: Every project linked to an installation falls back to its credential, or to public access. Installation tokens already minted stay valid on GitHub for up to an hour.
confirm.unlink_message: Projects pointing at this installation stop minting tokens at once and fall back to their credential. The App stays installed on GitHub.
confirm.delete_message: Removes the stored secret, its access and its tool settings. Agent runs that depend on it start failing at once. The key stays valid at {provider}, so revoke it there too.
confirm.discard_message: What you entered in this form is lost.

toasts.saved_no_grants: Saved without access. No task can use it until you pick a project, an environment or every task.

errors.stale: Couldn't refresh. Showing the list from {time} ago.
errors.providers_failed: Couldn't load the provider list. Reload the page to try again.
errors.ghapp_load_failed: Couldn't load the GitHub App status. {error}
errors.ghapp_app_id: Enter the App ID. It is a number.

oauth.server_help: The servers registered on /mcps/ with authentication set to a stored credential. The connection takes the credential name the registration asks for.
oauth.redirect_hint: If you register the client by hand (Slack), list exactly this redirect URL:
oauth.disconnect_message: Thulu revokes the tokens where the server allows it and forgets them. The credential and its access stay, so Reconnect brings it back.
oauth.servers_failed: Could not load the MCP servers. {error}
oauth.no_servers: No MCP server can be connected. Register one on /mcps/ with authentication set to a stored credential first.
